headline: Revenue and profit fall as transformation costs weigh
summary_short: Q2 2026 GAAP revenue fell 4.1% y/y to $5.29B (organic -5%), with diluted EPS of $1.17 (-37.1% y/y) and adjusted EPS of $1.84 (-26% y/y).
summary_long: GAAP revenue fell 4.1% y/y to $5.29B (organic -5%), with Financial Solutions down 8% and Merchant Solutions down 1% y/y. GAAP operating margin fell to 19.2% from 30.7% on One Fiserv transformation program expenses ($187M), severance ($40M), and higher SG&A; adjusted operating margin fell to 31.8% from 39.6%. GAAP diluted EPS was $1.17 (-37.1% y/y), cushioned by a $154M gain on early debt extinguishment from a June-July note tender and buyback; adjusted EPS was $1.84 (-26% y/y). The company repurchased $100M of stock and issued €1.0B of senior notes in the quarter. Cash and equivalents fell to $627M from $829M q/q. Fiserv updated its FY2026 outlook to (1%)-0% organic revenue growth and $7.20-$7.40 adjusted EPS.

drivers.explanation: CEO cites "volume growth and strong positions in attractive markets" as underlying support, but GAAP profit fell on One Fiserv transformation costs and softer Financial Solutions revenue.
Organic revenue fell 5% in the quarter, driven by an 8% decline in Financial Solutions and a 1% decline in Merchant Solutions.
GAAP operating margin fell to 19.2% from 30.7% on One Fiserv transformation program expenses ($187M), severance costs ($40M), and higher SG&A.
GAAP EPS fell with operating income but was cushioned by a $154M pretax gain on early debt extinguishment from the June-July note tender and buyback.
